frame_pairs: All chronological 1-based displayed-frame pairs, 1 <= i < j <= 32, admitted by the training generator's t2_reason.
selection: Within each dataset and answer stratum, sort by SHA256(item_id), then take the declared quota. IDs bind the seed, native capture, type, displayed pair and exact RGB32 identity. Never select using model output.
label_authority: Pinned native ground-truth OpenCV camera-to-world poses in metres, Z-up gravity, exact per-frame intrinsics and RGB32 source-frame joins. Labels use the existing training generator's eight-decimal pose and printed-answer conventions.
scoring: Sealed evalpath official MRA for signed numeric rotation and metric displacement; official exact match for direction letters. Strict native script answers must replay every selected GT label.
prior_failure: Preserve candidates and audit, refuse the freeze, and report the failed qualification. Do not silently relax a quota or select another hash seed.
